model: For each M0..255 and the two observed columns, wave=(M>=128)+2*(highercolumn). BF16_RNE(BF16(0x0810+0x0200*wave)*X[k,M]) equals the stored word. One common retained X row k supplies all512 words.
exactness: All calculations for product generation and BF16 rounding use signed integer dyadics. Every finite-BF16 lookup entry is checked against exact midpoint/tie-even preimages. Every matching row gets512 exact interval checks and productFP32-representability checks, so rounding through FP32 yields the same BF16 result on all matches.
limits: A match is a numerical model fit and preserves every candidate k; it does not select the physical K position or prove one physical corrupting multiply.
